### 1.4 Execution Sequence (normal Owner AI task)

```
1. Owner sends message → POST /api/ivx/owner-ai (Bearer JWT)
2. assertIVXOwnerOnly → verify Supabase JWT + email allowlist
3. Task Classifier → route to one of 5 branches
4. If durable task: POST /api/ivx/owner-ai/tasks
   a. enqueueOwnerAITask → check idempotency key → persist row (QUEUED) → return 202 + taskId
   b. Client polls GET /api/ivx/owner-ai/tasks/:id
   c. Background worker claims task (RUNNING) → call requestIVXAIText → answer
   d. persistAssistantReply → COMPLETED → VERIFIED
5. If sensitive write: owner-only.ts → phrase-gated (409 without confirmText)
6. If deploy: TEAM-12 only → phrase CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL → Git Data API → Render trigger → poll → /health verify
7. Proof Ledger row inserted (commit + deploy + live + match) → final_status computed
8. Owner report posted to chat (2h cadence)
```

| Network reset | ECONNRESET | TRANSIENT | YES | auto-retry | fallback chain |
| Provider 401/403 | HTTP status | PERMANENT | NO | credential rotation | markProviderFailed → 60s cooldown → half-open probe |
| Provider 400/422 | HTTP status | PERMANENT | NO | fix input | 400 returned to client |
| Render restart mid-task | stale heartbeat >3min | ORPHAN | YES | recoverOrphanTasks → RETRYING | worker ID changes, task completes on new instance |
| Client 60s timeout | client abort | n/a | n/a (backend continues) | task persists in Supabase, client polls | 202 + taskId returned immediately |
| Duplicate send | idempotency key match | DUPLICATE | NO | return existing task | task 42c25419 (duplicate=true) |
| All retries exhausted | retry_count >= max_retries | DEAD_LETTER | NO (manual) | replayDeadLetterTasks | dead_letter=true flag |
| Provider circuit open | PROVIDER_FAILED / AI_UNAVAILABLE | LATCHED | NO (cooldown) | 60s recovery cooldown → half-open probe | shouldTryPrimary() re-opens circuit |
